plan: 2 Kings 23:1-20; 2 Chronicles 34:29-33; 2 Kings 23:21-28; 2 Chronicles 35:1-19; Nahum 1:1-15; Nahum 2:1-13; Nahum 3:1-19

readings.title: Anchoring the Covenant Guarantee
readings.subtitle: Yoshiyahu aligns the physical nation with the precise words of the Book of the Covenant.
readings.text: [2 Kings 23:1] And the sovereign sent, and they gathered <dn>את</dn> all the elders of Yehuḏah and Yerushalayim to him. [2] And the sovereign went up to the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with all the men of Yehuḏah, and all the inhabitants of Yerushalayim with him, and the priests and the prophets and all the people, both small and great. And he read in their hearing <dn>את</dn> all the words of the Book of the Covenant which had been found in the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [3] And the sovereign stood by the column and made <dn>את</dn> a covenant before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to follow <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and to guard <dn>His</dn> commands and <dn>His</dn> witnesses and <dn>His</dn> laws, with all his heart and all his being, to establish <dn>את</dn> the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.

readings.title: Purging the Adversarial Engines
readings.subtitle: The high priest extracts Bavel's systemic corruption from the Hěḵal of YeHoVaH.
readings.text: [2 Kings 23:4] Then the sovereign commanded Ḥilqiyahu the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the doorkeepers, to bring out of the Hěḵal of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>את</dn> all the objects that were made for Ba‛al, and for Ashěrah, and for all the host of the heavens. And he burned them outside Yerushalayim in the fields of Qiḏron, and took <dn>את</dn> their ashes to Běyth Ěl. [5] And he put down <dn>את</dn> the black-robed priests whom the sovereigns of Yehuḏah had appointed to burn incense on the high places in the cities of Yehuḏah and in the places all around Yerushalayim, and those who burned incense to Ba‛al, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the constellations, and to all the host of the heavens.

readings.title: Dismantling the Cult of Asherah
readings.subtitle: The artifacts of the left arm's pagan traditions are ground to ashes and scattered.
readings.text: [6] And he brought out <dn>את</dn> the Ashěrah from the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to the wadi Qiḏron outside Yerushalayim, and burned it at the wadi Qiḏron and ground it to ashes, and threw its ashes on the burial-sites of the sons of the people. [7] And he broke down <dn>את</dn> the houses of the male cult prostitutes that were in the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, where the women wove tapestries for the Ashěrah.

readings.title: Defiling the High Places and Topheth
readings.subtitle: Yoshiyahu neutralizes the unauthorized centers of worship and the catastrophic sacrifice of children.
readings.text: [2 Kings 23:8] And he brought <dn>את</dn> all the priests from the cities of Yehuḏah, and defiled <dn>את</dn> the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geḇa to Be’ěrsheḇa, and broke down <dn>את</dn> the high places at the gates which were at the entrance of the Gate of Yehoshua the governor of the city, which were to the left of the city gate. [9] However, the priests of the high places did not come up to the slaughter-place of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> in Yerushalayim, but they ate unleavened bread among their brothers. [10] And he defiled <dn>את</dn> Topheth, which is in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, so that no man could make his son or his daughter pass through the fire to Moleḵ.

readings.title: Shattering Solomon's Compromise
readings.subtitle: The monuments to the sun god and ancient abominations are obliterated from the landscape.
readings.text: [11] And he did away with <dn>את</dn> the horses that the sovereigns of Yehuḏah had given to the sun, at the entrance to the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, by the room of Nathan-Meleḵ the eunuch, that were in the court. And he burned <dn>את</dn> the chariots of the sun with fire. [12] And <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-places that were on the roof of the upper room of Aḥaz, which the sovereigns of Yehuḏah had made, and <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-places which Menashsheh had made in the two courtyards of the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, the sovereign broke down, and rushed from there, and threw their dust into the wadi Qiḏron. [13] And the sovereign defiled <dn>את</dn> the high places that were before Yerushalayim, which were on the right hand of the Mountain of Destruction, which Shelomoh sovereign of Yisra’ěl built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Tsiḏonians, and for Kemosh the abomination of the Mo’aḇites, and for Milkom the abomination of the children of Ammon. [14] And he broke in pieces <dn>את</dn> the pillars and cut down <dn>את</dn> the Ashěrim, and filled their places with the bones of men.

readings.title: Executing the Prophetic Verdict at Bethel
readings.subtitle: The altar of Jeroboam is pulverized, fulfilling the precise historical decree while honoring the true prophet's bones.
readings.text: [2 Kings 23:15] And also <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-place that was at Běyth Ěl, and the high place which Yaroḇ‛am son of Neḇat made, by which he made Yisra’ěl sin, both <dn>את</dn> that slaughter-place and <dn>את</dn> the high place he broke down. And he burned the high place and ground it to dust, and burned the Ashěrah. [16] Then Yoshiyahu turned, and saw the burial-sites that were there on the mountain. And he sent and took <dn>את</dn> the bones out of the burial-sites and burned them on the slaughter-place, and defiled it according to the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> which the man of <dn>Elohim</dn> proclaimed, who proclaimed these words. [17] And he said, “What tombstone is this that <dn>I</dn> see?” And the men of the city said to him, “It is the burial-site of the man of <dn>Elohim</dn> who came from Yehuḏah and proclaimed these matters which you have done against the slaughter-place of Běyth Ěl.” [18] And he said, “Let him alone, let no one move his bones.” So they left his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet who came from Shomeron.

readings.title: The Eradication of Samaria's Priests
readings.subtitle: The agents of systemic disharmony are permanently removed from the high places.
readings.text: [19] And Yoshiyahu also took away <dn>את</dn> all the houses of the high places that were in the cities of Shomeron, which the sovereigns of Yisra’ěl had made to provoke. And he did to them according to all the deeds he did in Běyth Ěl. [20] And he slaughtered all the priests of the high places who were there, on the slaughter-places, and burned men’s bones on them, and went back to Yerushalayim.

readings.title: A Unified Oath of Absolute Trust
readings.subtitle: The sovereign mandates systemic harmony and diligent service across all the lands of Yisra’ěl.
readings.text: [2 Chronicles 34:29] And the sovereign sent and gathered <dn>את</dn> all the elders of Yehuḏah and Yerushalayim. [30] And the sovereign went up to the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with all the men of Yehuḏah and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim, and the priests and the Lěvites, and all the people, both great and small. And he read in their hearing <dn>את</dn> all the words of the Book of the Covenant which had been found in the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [31] And the sovereign stood in his place and made <dn>את</dn> a covenant before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to follow <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and to guard <dn>His</dn> commands and <dn>His</dn> witnesses and <dn>His</dn> laws, with all his heart and all his being, to do the words of the covenant that were written in this book. [32] And he made stand <dn>את</dn> all who were present in Yerushalayim and Binyamin. And the inhabitants of Yerushalayim did according to the covenant of <dn>Elohim</dn>, the <dn>Elohim</dn> of their fathers. [33] And Yoshiyahu removed <dn>את</dn> all the abominations from all the lands that belonged to the children of Yisra’ěl, and made all who were present in Yisra’ěl diligently serve <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> their <dn>Elohim</dn>. All his days they did not turn away from following <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of their fathers.

readings.title: The Decisive Halting Rehearsed
readings.subtitle: Yoshiyahu commands the observance of the Pěsaḥ, restoring the mandatory prophetic rehearsal.
readings.text: [2 Kings 23:21] And the sovereign commanded all the people, saying, “Prepare <dn>את</dn> the Pěsaḥ to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, as it is written in this Book of the Covenant.” [22] For such a Pěsaḥ had not been prepared since the days of the rulers who ruled Yisra’ěl, nor in all the days of the sovereigns of Yisra’ěl and the sovereigns of Yehuḏah, [23] but in the eighteenth year of Sovereign Yoshiyahu this Pěsaḥ was prepared before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> in Yerushalayim.

readings.title: The Inevitable Verdict on Judah
readings.subtitle: Despite Yoshiyahu's unparalleled return to the Torah, the accumulated debt of Manasseh's provocations seals Jerusalem's exile.
readings.text: [24] And also, Yoshiyahu put away <dn>את</dn> those who consulted mediums and spiritists, and <dn>את</dn> the household mighty ones and <dn>את</dn> idols, and <dn>את</dn> all the abominations that were seen in the land of Yehuḏah and in Yerushalayim, in order to establish <dn>את</dn> the words of the Torah which were written in the book that Ḥilqiyahu the priest found in the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [25] And before him there was no sovereign like him, who turned back to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with all his heart, and with all his being, and with all his might, according to all the Torah of Mosheh; and after him none rose up like him. [26] However, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> did not turn from the fierceness of <dn>His</dn> great wrath, with which <dn>His</dn> wrath burned against Yehuḏah, because of all the provocations with which Menashsheh had provoked <dn>Him</dn>. [27] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said, <dq>“Even <dn>את</dn> Yehuḏah <dn>I</dn> shall remove from <dn>My</dn> presence, as <dn>I</dn> have removed Yisra’ěl, and <dn>I</dn> shall reject this city Yerushalayim which <dn>I</dn> have chosen, and the House of which <dn>I</dn> said, ‘<dn>My</dn> Name is there.’ ”</dq> [28] And the rest of the acts of Yoshiyahu, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the sovereigns of Yehuḏah?

readings.title: Architects of the Pěsaḥ
readings.subtitle: The priests and Levites are structurally ordered to execute the decisive intervention according to the precise instructions of Mosheh.
readings.text: [2 Chronicles 35:1] And Yoshiyahu performed <dn>את</dn> a Pěsaḥ to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> in Yerushalayim, and they slew the Pěsaḥ on the fourteenth day of the first new moon. [2] And he set the priests in their duties and strengthened them for the service of the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, [3] and said to the Lěvites who were teaching all Yisra’ěl, who were set-apart to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “Put <dn>את</dn> the set-apart ark in the house which Shelomoh son of Daviḏ, sovereign of Yisra’ěl, built. It is no longer to be a burden on your shoulders. Now serve <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> and <dn>His</dn> people Yisra’ěl, [4] and prepare by the fathers’ houses, according to your divisions, by the writing of Daviḏ sovereign of Yisra’ěl and by the writing of Shelomoh his son. [5] “And stand in the set-apart place by the divisions of the fathers’ houses of your brothers the lay people, and the portion of the father’s house of the Lěvites. [6] “And slay <dn>את</dn> the Pěsaḥ, and set yourselves apart, and prepare for your brothers, to do according to the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> by the hand of Mosheh.”

readings.title: The Sovereign's Surplus Released
readings.subtitle: Tens of thousands of offerings are distributed, demonstrating a restorative economy of abundance.
readings.text: [2 Chronicles 35:7] And Yoshiyahu gave the lay people lambs and young goats from the flock, all for Pěsaḥim for everyone present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand cattle – these were from the sovereign’s possessions. [8] And his leaders contributed a voluntary offering to the people, to the priests, and to the Lěvites. Ḥilqiyah, and Zeḵaryahu, and Yeḥi’ěl, leaders of the House of <dn>Elohim</dn>, gave to the priests for the Pěsaḥim two thousand six hundred, and three hundred cattle; [9] and Konanyahu, his brothers Shemayahu and Nethan’ěl, and Ḥashaḇyahu and Ye‛i’ěl and Yozaḇaḏ, chiefs of the Lěvites, gave to the Lěvites for Pěsaḥim five thousand, and five hundred cattle.

readings.title: Executing the Divine Economy
readings.subtitle: The sacrificial system operates in strict behavioral order, processing the offerings rapidly for the assembled nation.
readings.text: [2 Chronicles 35:10] And the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their places, and the Lěvites in their divisions, according to the command of the sovereign, [11] and they slew <dn>את</dn> the Pěsaḥ. And the priests sprinkled out of their hands, while the Lěvites were skinning. [12] And they removed <dn>את</dn> the ascending offerings, to give them to the divisions of the fathers’ houses of the lay people, to bring to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, as it is written in the Book of Mosheh, and the same with the cattle. [13] So they roasted <dn>את</dn> the Pěsaḥ with fire according to the right-ruling, and they boiled the set-apart offerings in pots, and in cauldrons, and in bowls, and brought them speedily to all the lay people. [14] And afterward they prepared for themselves and for the priests, because the priests, the sons of Aharon, were offering ascending offerings and fat until night. So the Lěvites prepared for themselves and for the priests, the sons of Aharon. [15] And the singers, the sons of Asaph, were in their places, according to the command of Daviḏ, and Asaph, and Hěman, and Yeḏuthun the seer of the sovereign. And the gatekeepers at each gate did not have to leave their position, because their brothers the Lěvites prepared for them.

readings.title: The Ultimate Prophetic Rehearsal
readings.subtitle: A historically unprecedented Pěsaḥ is executed, perfectly aligning the nation with the redemptive calendar.
readings.text: [2 Chronicles 35:16] And all the service of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> was prepared that day, to perform <dn>את</dn> the Pěsaḥ and to offer ascending offerings on the slaughtplace of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, according to the command of Sovereign Yoshiyahu. [17] And the children of Yisra’ěl who were present performed <dn>את</dn> the Pěsaḥ at that time, and <dn>את</dn> the Festival of Matzot for seven days. [18] There had not been a Pěsaḥ performed in Yisra’ěl like it since the days of Shemu’ěl the prophet. And none of the sovereigns of Yisra’ěl had performed such a Pěsaḥ as Yoshiyahu performed, with the priests and the Lěvites, and all Yehuḏah and Yisra’ěl who were present, and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim. [19] In the eighteenth year of the reign of Yoshiyahu this Pěsaḥ was performed.

readings.title: The Physics of Divine State
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH’s uncontained essence disrupts the physical cosmos, exposing the crushing weight of His presence against all adversaries.
readings.text: [Nahum 1:1] The message concerning <dn>את</dn> Ninevěh. The book of the vision of Naḥum the Elqoshite. [2] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is a jealous and revenging <dn>Ěl</dn>, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is a revenger and a possessor of wrath. <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> takes vengeance on <dn>His</dn> adversaries, and <dn>He</dn> watches for <dn>His</dn> enemies. [3] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is patient and great in power, but by no means leaves unpunished. <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has <dn>His</dn> way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of <dn>His</dn> feet. [4] <dn>He</dn> is rebuking the sea and dries it up. And all the floods <dn>He</dn> has made dry, Bashan and Karmel are withering, and the flower of Leḇanon is languishing. [5] Mountains have shaken before <dn>Him</dn>, and the hills have melted. And the earth is lifted up at <dn>His</dn> presence, and the world and all who dwell in it.

readings.title: The Stronghold of Emunah
readings.subtitle: Absolute Justice pours out like fire on Ninevěh, while providing impenetrable refuge for those who fully lean on His guarantee.
readings.text: [6] Who does stand before <dn>His</dn> rage? And who rises up in the heat of <dn>His</dn> displeasure? <dn>His</dn> wrath is poured out like fire, and the rocks have been broken by <dn>Him</dn>. [7] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is good, as a stronghold in the day of distress. And <dn>He</dn> knows those who take refuge in <dn>Him</dn>. [8] But with an overwhelming flood <dn>He</dn> makes a complete end of the place of Ninevěh, and darkness does pursue <dn>His</dn> enemies.

readings.title: Severing the Adversary's Yoke
readings.subtitle: The decree of total annihilation against the engineered epicenter of Assyria frees Judah to perform its authorized vows.
readings.text: [Nahum 1:9] What do you plot against <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>? <dn>He</dn> makes a complete end of it. Distress does not rise up a second time. [10] Though they are as entangled thorns, and as drunkards with their drink, they shall be consumed like stubble thoroughly dried. [11] From you came forth one who plots evil against <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, a counsellor of Beliya‛al. [12] Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“Though they are strong and many, even so, they shall be cut off and pass away. Though <dn>I</dn> have afflicted you, <dn>I</dn> afflict you no more.</dq> [13] <dq>“So now <dn>I</dn> break his yoke from you, and tear off your shackles.”</dq> [14] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has commanded concerning you, <dq>“Your name shall no longer be sown. From the house of your mighty ones <dn>I</dn> shall cut off <dn>את</dn> the carved image and <dn>את</dn> the moulded image. <dn>I</dn> shall appoint your burial-site, for you have been of no account.”</dq> [15] See, on the mountains the feet of him who brings good news, who proclaims peace! O Yehuḏah, celebrate your festivals, perform your vows. For Beliya‛al shall no more pass through you. <dn>He</dn> has been cut off completely.

readings.title: The Siege Engine Unleashed
readings.subtitle: The military complex of Ninevěh crumbles as the river gates open and the palace structure dissolves.
readings.text: [Nahum 2:1] He who breaks in pieces has come up before your face. Guard the ramparts! Watch the way! Strengthen your loins! Fortify your power very much. [2] For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall turn back <dn>את</dn> the splendour of Ya‛aqoḇ like the splendour of Yisra’ěl, for the emptiers have emptied them out and ruined their vine branches. [3] The shields of his mighty men have become red, the men of battle are in scarlet. The chariots are like flaming torches in the day of his preparation, and the cypresses shall be shaken. [4] The chariots dash about in the streets, they rush one another in the broad ways. They look like flaming torches, they run like lightning. [5] He remembers his noble ones, they stumble in their walk, they hurry to her walls, and the defence is prepared. [6] The river gates have been opened, and the palace is melted. [7] And it is established: she shall be exiled, she shall be led away. And her female servants are moaning as with the voice of doves, beating on their breasts.

readings.title: Plundering the Apex Predators
readings.subtitle: The den of lions—the historic engine of predatory economics—is hollowed out by the Right Arm's command.
readings.text: [8] And Ninevěh of old was like a pool of water, now they flee away. “Stop! Stop!” they cry, but no one turns back. [9] Plunder the silver! Plunder the gold! There is no limit to the treasure – a wealth of all precious objects. [10] She is empty, even emptiness and waste! And the heart has melted, and the knees have knocked together, and much pain is in all loins, and all their faces have become flushed. [11] Where is the den of the lions, and the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion, the lioness and the lion’s cub walked, with no one to disturb them? [12] The lion tore in pieces enough for his cubs, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his caves with prey, and his dens with torn prey. [13] <dq>“See, <dn>I</dn> am against you,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, <dq>“and <dn>I</dn> shall burn your chariots in smoke, and the sword devour <dn>את</dn> your young lions. And <dn>I</dn> shall cut off <dn>את</dn> your prey from the earth, and no longer is the voice of your messengers heard.”</dq>

readings.title: The Terminal State of the Bloody City
readings.subtitle: The mistress of sorceries, built on lies and stolen wealth, is publicly stripped and made a permanent spectacle.
readings.text: [Nahum 3:1] Woe to the city of blood! All of it is a lie, filled with plunder, the prey is not lacking. [2] The sound of a whip and the sound of rattling wheels, of galloping horses, of jolting chariots, [3] mounted horsemen with bright sword and glittering spear, and many wounded, and a mass of dead bodies, and no end of corpses, they stumble over the corpses – [4] because of the many whorings of the well-favoured whore, the mistress of sorceries, who sells nations by her whorings, and clans by her sorceries. [5] <dq>“See, <dn>I</dn> am against you,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, <dq>“and shall lift up <dn>את</dn> your skirts over your face, and shall show nations your nakedness, and reigns your shame.</dq> [6] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall cast abominations upon you, and treat you as foolish, and make a spectacle of you.</dq> [7] <dq>“And it shall be that all who see you flee from you, and say, ‘Ninevěh is laid waste! Who does mourn for her?’ Where do <dn>I</dn> seek comforters for you?”</dq>

readings.title: The Illusion of Fortified Power
readings.subtitle: Like No Amon before her, Ninevěh's human-engineered strongholds and historical alliances offer zero protection from the cosmic verdict.
readings.text: [Nahum 3:8] Are you better than No Amon, who dwelt by the Nile-streams, with waters around her, whose rampart was like the sea, whose wall was like the sea? [9] Kush and Mitsrayim were her strength, even unlimited. Put and Luḇim were your helpers. [10] Yet she was exiled, she went into captivity. At the head of every street her young children were dashed to pieces. Lots were cast for her esteemed men, and all her great men were bound in chains. [11] You too are to become drunk, you are to go into hiding. You too are to seek refuge from the enemy. [12] All your strongholds are fig trees with ripened figs, when shaken they shall fall into the mouth of the eater. [13] See, your people in your midst are women! The gates of your land shall be opened wide to your enemies. Fire shall consume <dn>את</dn> your gate bars.

readings.title: The Final Accounting of Debt
readings.subtitle: An incurable wound is dealt to the sovereign of Ashshur, as all victims of his retributive system celebrate his permanent ruin.
readings.text: [14] Draw for yourself water for the siege! Strengthen your defences! Go into the clay and tread the mortar, lay hold of the brick mould! [15] There a fire shall consume you, a sword cut you off, eat you up like a locust. Make yourself many like the locust, make yourself many like the swarming locust! [16] You have increased your merchants more than the stars of the heavens. The locust shall strip off and fly away. [17] Your officials are like the locusts, and your marshals are like the great grasshoppers, which settle in the hedges on a cold day – when the sun rises they flee away, and the place where they are is unknown. [18] Your shepherds have slumbered, O sovereign of Ashshur, your nobles lie down to rest. Your people are scattered on the mountains, and no one gathers them. [19] Your injury has no healing, your wound is grievous. All who hear news of you shall clap their hands over you. For over whom did your evil not pass continually?
